description: Seed SQLAlchemy models as a coherent graph of test data in one call, with every foreign key verified against the row it points at
rules: Create SQLAlchemy test data with the seed function instead of building objects or setting foreign key ids by hand
The seed function flushes and verifies every foreign key but never commits, so the caller commits or rolls back
Pass rows that already exist through the parents argument, since a shape key towards a parent is refused
Give a required JSON or custom type column a generator through the generators argument, keyed by model then column
The generators and overrides arguments name a column by its database name, not by its Python attribute name
In pytest, use the seedgraph_graph fixture, or seedgraph_agraph for async code, which gives each test a fresh SQLite database
